description.value: Kelowna Karting is an indoor entertainment centre offering high-speed electric go-kart racing on a technical indoor track, along with free-roam Zero Latency VR, BC's only Gel Blaster Nexus arena, laser tag, interactive axe throwing, and an arcade. It caters to families, birthday parties, and corporate events, making it a potential rainy-day activity for touring cyclists passing through Kelowna.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Kelowna Karting is an indoor entertainment centre (electric go-karting, VR, gel blaster, axe throwing, arcade) at 200 Campion Street, Kelowna. The website confirms the address and the phone number 250-470-0776 in the footer across all pages, matching OSM, though the contact page body text lists a different number (877-935-1885). No evidence was found on the website for any cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms are not mentioned), so all required criteria are null. The business is clearly operational with active hiring and a 2026 copyright.
concerns: Contact page body text lists phone 877-935-1885 while footer across all pages and OSM both show 250-470-0776; the business may have two numbers (local and toll-free)
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate and operational entertainment venue that could appeal to touring cyclists, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. wow_evidence: Indoor electric karting plus VR and laser tag; fun rainy-day commercial rec, no independent story.
blurb: Indoor electric go-kart track with VR arena and laser tag in Kelowna.
